title: Workday Activity Logging connector (Beta)
body:
The Workday Activity Logging connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector incrementally ingests Workday user activity log events into Databricks. Authentication uses an OAuth refresh token.

See [Workday Activity Logging connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/workday-activity-logging).
